ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: B2C (Business-to-Customer, business to customer) is a sales model that relies on the rapid development of the Internet. The development of the B2C model depends on the continuous development of what industry?

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: B2C (Business-to-Customer, business to customer) is a sales model that relies on the rapid development of the Internet. The development of the B2C model depends on the continuous development of what industry?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First look at the image: in the center of the schematic diagram is "Internet platform", and around it are connected links such as "customer flow", "capital flow", "transaction flow", "commodity flow", and "logistics", among which the link "logistics" clearly appears. Then read the question stem: the question asks what industry's continuous development the development of the B2C model depends on. B2C is an Internet sales model from merchants to customers; after an online transaction is completed, the delivery of goods from the merchant to the customer needs logistics support; the original judgment item in the question stem also has "depends on the continuous development of the modern logistics industry". Therefore the answer is the modern logistics industry.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的交易流程：互联网平台连接客户流、资金流、交易流、商品流和物流。再读题干，确认问题问的是B2C模式发展依赖的行业。最后在题干原有判断项中找到“依赖于现代物流业不断地发展”，并用图中“物流”环节作验证，回答“现代物流业”。
method.CoT_raw: 先看图像：示意图中央是“互联网平台”，周围连接着“客户流”“资金流”“交易流”“商品流”和“物流”等环节，其中明确出现了“物流”这一环节。再读题干：问题问的是B2C模式的发展依赖于什么行业不断发展。B2C是商家对顾客的互联网销售模式，网上交易完成后，商品从商家送达顾客需要物流支持；题干原判断项中也有“依赖于现代物流业不断地发展”。因此答案是现代物流业。
